name: MonarchRookBar
title: RookBar
wrapsNative: HStack bar with MonarchButton and Menu; .sheet with a NavigationStack and a List of DisclosureGroups for the menus; openURL for links
summary: The Rook company bar for the public and signed-out screens of a Rook app: the brand, the account controls and a menu button that opens every Rook menu (products, services, pricing, news) in a full-height sheet.
whenToUse: At the top of a Rook app's signed-out, welcome or about screens, so they carry the same company navigation as Rook's websites. Rook-scoped.
whenNotToUse: Outside Rook's own apps, use MonarchSiteShell. In the signed-in app, use a TabView or NavigationSplitView and the account screen.
api: init(_ brand: String, mark: Image? = nil, items: [MonarchRookBarItem], account: MonarchRookBarAccount? = nil, labels: MonarchRookBarLabels = MonarchRookBarLabels(), onSignOut: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchRookBarItem.init(_ id: String, label: String, groups: [MonarchRookBarGroup])
MonarchRookBarItem.init(_ id: String, label: String, destination: URL?)
MonarchRookBarGroup.init(_ title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, links: [MonarchRookBarLink])
MonarchRookBarLink.init(_ label: String, destination: URL? = nil, description: String? = nil, meta: String? = nil, isExternal: Bool = false)
enum MonarchRookBarAccount { case signedOut(signInURL: URL?, signUpURL: URL?), signedIn(name: String, dashboardURL: URL?, accountURL: URL?) }

MonarchRookBarLabels.init(navigation: String? = nil, openMenu: String? = nil, closeMenu: String? = nil, accountMenu: String? = nil, dashboard: String? = nil, account: String? = nil, signOut: String? = nil, signIn: String? = nil, signUp: String? = nil)

options.name: brand
options.description: The app's name beside its mark.

options.name: mark
options.description: The app's mark; without it the brand's first letter is shown in a tile.

options.name: items
options.description: Menus with groups of links, and plain links such as Pricing, in order.

options.name: account
options.description: Signed out (Log in and Sign up) or signed in (an avatar menu); without it no account controls.

options.name: onSignOut
options.description: Signs the person out; without it Sign out is not shown.

states.name: signed out
states.description: Log in (ghost) and Sign up (primary) beside the menu button; Log in is dropped when the bar is too narrow.

states.name: signed in
states.description: An avatar with the person's initials opens a menu: the name, Open dashboard, Account settings and Sign out.

states.name: menu open
states.description: A full-height sheet titled with the brand: a collapsible group per menu, plain links, and the account controls at the end.

appearance: The bar uses the surface colour with a divider under it; the brand is semibold in the default text colour beside its mark or a letter tile on the muted background. Link descriptions in the sheet use the muted text colour. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web RookBar is the company bar of every Rook website, with hover menus that open wide panels (an app catalogue, a featured card, recent posts) and a full-height sheet on phones. On iOS there is no hover and no page header: the bar is a view placed at the top of the screen, and its menus are always the full-height sheet, as on a phone on the web, with each panel's content as groups of links. The web's scroll progress, colour scheme override and posts loaded on open are not offered; the app passes every link and post. Rook-scoped. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The bar is a container named "Rook" (or labels.navigation); the brand has the header trait.
The menu button is named "Open menu"; the sheet's close button is named "Close menu".
Each menu is a DisclosureGroup read with "Expanded" or "Collapsed"; group titles have the header trait.
Each link row is one link read as its title, its description and its meta line.
A signed-in person's avatar is a menu named "Account menu" with the name as its value.
edgeCases: A long brand is shortened to one line before the account controls.
A link without a destination closes the sheet and goes nowhere.
Without a sign-up link only Log in is shown.

examples.title: Signed out
examples.setup:
private let items: [MonarchRookBarItem] = [
    MonarchRookBarItem("products", label: "Products", groups: [
        MonarchRookBarGroup("Sales & Support", description: "Win customers, then look after them.", links: [
            MonarchRookBarLink("Pipeline", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/pipeline"), description: "Leads, deals and invoices."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Help desk", destination: URL(string: "https://desk.example.com"), description: "Support with a branded portal.", isExternal: true),
        ]),
        MonarchRookBarGroup("Collaboration", description: "Everyone on the same page.", links: [
            MonarchRookBarLink("Team chat", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/chat"), description: "Channels, calls and search."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Documents", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/docs"), description: "Docs the whole workspace can find."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Planner", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/planner"), description: "Plan sprints across teams."),
        ]),
        MonarchRookBarGroup("Platform", links: [
            MonarchRookBarLink("Accounts", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/accounts"), description: "One sign-in for every app."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Developers", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/developers"), description: "Guides and API docs."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Create your account", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/signup")),
        ]),
    ]),
    MonarchRookBarItem("services", label: "Services", groups: [
        MonarchRookBarGroup("When you need more than software.", description: "Tell us what you need. We will build it with you.", links: [
            MonarchRookBarLink("Visit our services site", destination: URL(string: "https://services.example.com"), isExternal: true),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Product engineering", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/engineering"), description: "Designed and built end to end."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Implementation", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/implementation"), description: "Brought into the way you work."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Consulting", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/consulting"), description: "Plans, reviews and audits."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Enterprise systems", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/enterprise"), description: "Engineered for scale."),
        ]),
    ]),
    MonarchRookBarItem("pricing", label: "Pricing", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/pricing")),
    MonarchRookBarItem("news", label: "News", groups: [
        MonarchRookBarGroup(links: [
            MonarchRookBarLink("Blog", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/blog"), description: "Ideas from the team."),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Press releases", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/press"), description: "Announcements."),
        ]),
        MonarchRookBarGroup(links: [
            MonarchRookBarLink("What we learned shipping a design system", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/posts/1"), meta: "Blog · Mar 2, 2026"),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Quarterly product update", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/posts/2"), meta: "Press · Feb 18, 2026"),
            MonarchRookBarLink("Our plans for the year", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/posts/3"), meta: "Letters · Jan 9, 2026"),
        ]),
    ]),
]
examples.code:
MonarchRookBar(
    "Northwind",
    items: items,
    account: .signedOut(
        signInURL: URL(string: "https://example.com/login"),
        signUpURL: URL(string: "https://example.com/signup")
    )
)
